decision.reason: The PR rewrites the core search loop of SelectCoinsBnB (wallet coin selection) with new control flow (SHIFT/CUT, lookahead, clone skipping, TOTAL_TRIES handling, attempt counting). This is a nontrivial behavioral refactor with money-relevant logic, so it is well suited to mutation testing.

files.reason: The BnB search was reimplemented. The changes cover lookahead computation, the insufficient-funds check, the max-weight and overshoot cuts, high-feerate waste pruning, best-solution tracking, the TOTAL_TRIES limit, clone skipping, and SetSelectionsEvaluated/SetAlgoCompleted. The final waste recalculation and assertion were dropped. Boundary and off-by-one mutants (comparison operators, index arithmetic, curr_try counter) are likely and should be caught by the exact attempt-count assertions.

unit.reason: Directly calls SelectCoinsBnB. The PR added expected-attempts checks to its BnB success cases, so it is sensitive to search order and the attempt counter.
Calls SelectCoinsBnB directly and through SelectCoins. The PR added GetSelectionsEvaluated assertions with exact counts (1, 3, 2, 22).
